name: com.midtrans.sdk.uikit.views.alfamart.status.AlfamartStatusActivity
description: After a user starts Alfamart store payments in Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen shows the payment result and the payment code, expiry time, and steps for paying at an Alfamart store.
disableEffect: Disabling it can hide the Alfamart store payments payment result or the instructions needed to complete it.
